So we need to see how many times each player selected the winning number. In their records, we need to match the number chosen by the player matches the winner number of that round. Now for each round, check if record equals winner number.

Round1: winner 30. None of players choose 30. So no win for each. Round2: winner 20. None of players choose 20. So no win. Round3: winner 15. None of players choose 15. So no win. Round4: winner 10. None of players choose 10. So no win. Round5: winner 8. Players 1,3,5,7 all have 8 in round5. So all four win that round. Round6: winner 5. Players 1,3,5,7 all have 5 in round6. So all four win. So all four win each of those rounds.

Thus total wins per player:

Player_1: wins in rounds 5,6,7,8,9,10-20. That's 4 wins in first 4 rounds? Wait rounds 5-9: 5 rounds (5-9 inclusive). Actually rounds 5-9: 5 rounds (5,6,7,8,9). Then rounds 10-20: 11 rounds. So total 5+11=16 wins.

Player_3: same logic: wins rounds 5-9 (5 rounds) plus 10-20 (11 rounds) = 16 wins.

Player_5: wins rounds 5-6 (2 rounds), 8-9 (2 rounds), 10-20 (11 rounds). Also does not win round7. So 2+2+11=15 wins.

Player_7: wins rounds 5-6, 8-9, 10-20, but also round7? Wait player 7 has 3 in round7. So yes wins round7 too. Actually he has 3 in round7. So he wins round7. So same as player_1 and 3? He has 3 in round7, so he wins round7 too. So 5-9: 5 rounds, 10-20: 11 rounds => 16 wins.

Thus player_5 has 15 wins vs others 16. So player_5 won least times. So answer is C.
